name: Expense Report
description: Expense report with line items, used to demonstrate projecting operations into the analytics engine

modules.name: line-items
modules.description: Add, update, and delete expense line items.

operations.name: ADD_LINE_ITEM
operations.description: Append a line item. id and date come from input (reducers must be deterministic). date is the expense date (business time), formatted as an ISO date such as 2025-01-15. category may be hierarchical via '/', e.g. 'Headcount/Salaries'.
operations.schema:
input AddLineItemInput {
  id: String!
  amount: Float!
  currency: String!
  category: String!
  date: String!
}

errors.name: DuplicateLineItem
errors.description: A line item with this id already exists

operations.name: UPDATE_LINE_ITEM
operations.description: Update fields of an existing line item by id. Omitted fields are left unchanged.
operations.schema:
input UpdateLineItemInput {
  id: String!
  amount: Float
  currency: String
  category: String
  date: String
}

errors.name: LineItemNotFound
errors.description: No line item with this id exists

operations.name: DELETE_LINE_ITEM
operations.description: Remove a line item by id.

errors.name: LineItemNotFound
errors.description: No line item with this id exists
